name: uk-bookmaker-prices-sample
title: UK and Irish bookmaker prices: a sample snapshot
description: One snapshot, taken 2026-10-11T20:16:34Z, of pre-match prices from UK and Irish bookmakers, from the OddsRelay API's raw board and standard matched board. Bookmakers only: no exchange prices.

resources.name: bookmakers
resources.description: One row per bookmaker with at least one price in this sample.

fields.name: bookmaker_key
fields.description: Short identifier of the bookmaker, the same one the API uses. Joins to the price tables.

fields.name: bookmaker_name
fields.description: The bookmaker's name as it is displayed.

resources.name: events
resources.description: One row per event in this sample. On the raw board one fixture can appear as two events when bookmakers name or time it differently: compare sides and start times before counting fixtures.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Identifier of the event in the API. Use it to join these files; it is not meant as a permanent key.

fields.name: sport
fields.description: The sport, for example soccer, tennis or horse_racing.

fields.name: sport_key
fields.description: The competition's identifier, which starts with the sport.

fields.name: competition
fields.description: The competition's name, or the sport's name where there is no competition.

fields.name: commence_time
fields.description: Scheduled start, in UTC.

fields.name: home_team
fields.description: The home side, or the first-named player. Empty for events without sides, such as races.

fields.name: away_team
fields.description: The away side, or the second-named player. Empty for events without sides.

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: The event's name where it does not split into two sides. Often empty.

fields.name: course
fields.description: Racing only: the racecourse, where the matched board names it. Otherwise empty.

resources.name: raw_prices
resources.description: One row per price on the raw board: one bookmaker, one event, one market, one outcome. Outcome names are each bookmaker's own.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: The event (events.csv).

fields.name: bookmaker_key
fields.description: The bookmaker (bookmakers.csv).

fields.name: market
fields.description: The market's key (DATA_DICTIONARY.md says what each one means).

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: The selection, worded as this bookmaker words it.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Decimal price: what one unit staked returns if the outcome wins, stake included.

fields.name: last_update
fields.description: When this bookmaker's prices on this market last changed, in UTC.

resources.name: matched_prices
resources.description: One row per bookmaker price on the standard matched board, where every bookmaker's offer on the same outcome sits under one outcome name. Exchange prices are left out.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: The event (events.csv).

fields.name: market
fields.description: The market's key (DATA_DICTIONARY.md says what each one means).

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: The selection, named once for every bookmaker.

fields.name: point
fields.description: The line on a line market, for example 2.5 on totals. Empty on other markets.

fields.name: bookmaker_key
fields.description: The bookmaker (bookmakers.csv).

fields.name: price
fields.description: Decimal price, as in raw_prices.csv.

resources.name: raw-board
resources.description: The sample's raw-board events in the API's own shape, bookmakers only: meta, then data, one object per event with each bookmaker's markets and outcomes.

resources.name: standard-board
resources.description: The sample's events on the standard matched board in the API's own shape, back prices only: meta, then data, one object per event with its markets, outcomes and the bookmakers' prices for each outcome, highest first.
